links.outcome: F1-score of ICD-10-CM autocoding on reference test set versus later real hospital data
links.effect: GPT-2 F1 was 0.667 on the KMUCHH test set (0.851 for top 50 codes) and slightly lower, 0.621, on real hospital data from 2023.
links.quote: Among all methods, the GPT-2 (OpenAI)-based model achieved the highest F<sub>1</sub>-score, 0.667 (F<sub>1</sub>-score 0.851 for the top 50 codes), on the KMUCHH test set and a slightly lower F<sub>1</sub>-score, 0.621, in real hospital data.

screen.reason: The study develops and deploys an NLP/GPT-2-based ICD-10 coding tool into the workflow of certified coding specialists in a real hospital environment and evaluates its coding agreement and accuracy, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
